'''Stygium armor''' was the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn's]] [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow stormtroopers]].<ref name="LSatSoM" /> The armor was made from a [[Stygian-triprismatic polymer/Legends|stygian-triprismatic polymer]] that rendered its wearer undetectable to [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|blackholestormtroopers|shadow stormtroopers}}</ref> It was [[Color/Legends|colored]] black, with [[Holocamera/Legends|holocameras]] and [[meltmassif]] embedded into the armor.<ref name="LSatSoM" />
{{Imp-stub}}
